newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal Z bonds to go in closed issue.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal Z bonds to go in closed issue.

text.p: The planned convertible bond issue by Polish builder Mostostal Zabrze SA will go in a closed issue and not a public offering, the firm's spokesman told daily Parkiet in its Tuesday issue.

"We've decided to conduct a closed issue directed toward at most 300 investors. If shareholders approve the motion the sale of the bonds should start in the autumn of this year," Adam Konopka was quoted as saying.
He said setting the exact timing of the issue would depend on the bourse climate in the autumn.
The paper said the firm had changed its previous plan for a public offering and bourse listing when the Securities Commission (KPW) delayed the issue's approval.
Mostostal shareholders meet on June 21 to decide on management's proposal to issue 400 five-year convertible bonds with a par value of 100,000 zlotys each exchangeable into two million shares.
The firm had previously planned to issue 250 bonds.
